# GitHub Pull Request #366

## Title
feat(durable): attach images from workspace.viewImage and nested tools

## Description
"Closes #365.\n\n## What changes\n\n- **Image collector for pi-durable** (`src/durable/images.ts`). `workspace.viewImage` reads the file with the same limits as on Pi (10 MiB source, 5 MiB encoded, 8 images and 16 MiB per invocation). It detects PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and BMP from the file's magic bytes and base64-encodes the image.\n  - With the new `PitDurableOptions.images` (an `ImageProcessor`, for example `await createNodePhotonImages()`), images are prepared to fit the model's limits: pi-durable's defaults, overridden by `inputLimits.images.resize`, capped at 5 MiB. The note says what was converted or resized and how to map coordinates back.\n  - Without a processor, inline formats within the byte limit pass through unchanged, as with pi-durable's `read`. BMP and images that are too large fail with a clear error.\n  - With a text-only model, the result says the image was left out (`omitted: true`), as on Pi.\n- **Results carry the images** (`src/durable/tool.ts`). One `images.attached()` snapshot provides the metadata for `buildToolResult` and the `ImageContent` blocks added to `output`.\n- **Images from nested tools** (`src/durable/tools.ts`). Images are attached in both branches, including tools with a `structuredOutputSchema`. Those used to drop their images with no notice.\n- **Shared logic.** The bounded file read and the per-invocation slot and limit logic move out of `view-image.ts` into `src/workspace/image-attachments.ts`, which doesn't import `pi-coding-agent`. The Pi collector now uses that module too, with the same behavior.\n- The durable entry still uses pi-durable only for types: the default limits are copied, and a test checks the copy against `DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS`.\n- Docs: `workspace.viewImage` is no longer listed as unavailable in the tool description, `docs/durable.md` and the README. `docs/durable.md` has a new Images section and an `images` option row, and the changelog is updated.\n\n## Tests\n\nThe stub's tests are replaced with Harness tests in `test/durable/harness.test.ts`. They check:\n- the PNG reaches the model's next request\n- the text-only note\n- magic-byte detection\n- refusals without a processor\n- processor notes and limits\n- the model's resize profile and the cap\n- a nested tool with a schema that returns an image\n\nThe test host can now set the faux model's `input` and `inputLimits`. `delivery.validate` passes (static checks, tests, coverage).\n\n## For hosts\n\npi-action can opt in with:\n\n```ts\nimport { createNodePhotonImages } from \"@earendil-works/pi-durable/images/node\";\nfactory.create({ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui, log, images: await createNodePhotonImages() });\n```\n\nWithout a processor there is no check on pixel dimensions, only on bytes. Very large PNGs within 4.5 MiB pass through unchanged, so hosts should pass a processor."

 ## What works
 
-- `workspace.*` except `viewImage`, `shell.*`, `git.*`, `npm.*`, `gh.*`, `http.*`, and the other command globals, in the conversation's working directory.
+- `workspace.*`, `shell.*`, `git.*`, `npm.*`, `gh.*`, `http.*`, and the other command globals, in the conversation's working directory.
 - Saved functions in every scope. Session functions are conversation entries; user and project functions load from disk as on Pi. `functions.*` manages them.

+Pit recognizes PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and BMP files by their magic bytes. How it prepares them depends on the `images` option:

@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+import type { ModelInputLimits } from "@earendil-works/pi-ai";
+import type { ImageLimits, ImageProcessor } from "@earendil-works/pi-durable/tools";
+
+import {
+  type AttachedImage,
+  createImageAttachments,
+  type ImageCollector,
+  MAX_ENCODED_BYTES,
+  readImageSource,
+} from "../workspace/image-attachments.js";
+import { checkAbort } from "../workspace/paths.js";
+
+/** The conversation model's image input, as pi-durable's `read` reads it. */
+export interface DurableImageModel {
+  readonly input: readonly string[];
+  readonly inputLimits?: ModelInputLimits;
+}
+
+/** Formats every provider takes inline; others, such as BMP, need an image processor. */
+const INLINE_TYPES = new Set(["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/gif", "image/webp"]);
+
+function startsWith(bytes: Uint8Array, prefix: readonly number[], offset = 0): boolean {
+  return prefix.every((byte, index) => bytes[offset + index] === byte);
+}
+
+const ascii = (text: string) => [...text].map((char) => char.charCodeAt(0));
+
+/** The image type the file's magic bytes declare, or `undefined` for anything else. */
+export function detectImageType(bytes: Uint8Array): string | undefined {
+  if (startsWith(bytes, [0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a])) return "image/png";
+  if (startsWith(bytes, [0xff, 0xd8, 0xff])) return "image/jpeg";
+  if (startsWith(bytes, ascii("GIF87a")) || startsWith(bytes, ascii("GIF89a"))) return "image/gif";
+  if (startsWith(bytes, ascii("RIFF")) && startsWith(bytes, ascii("WEBP"), 8)) return "image/webp";
+  if (startsWith(bytes, ascii("BM")) && bytes.length >= 26) return "image/bmp";
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+/**
+ * pi-durable's `DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS`, which `read` applies too. Copied, so the durable entry
+ * keeps needing pi-durable only for types.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS: ImageLimits = {
+  maxWidth: 2000,
+  maxHeight: 2000,
+  maxBytes: 4.5 * 1024 * 1024,
+};
+
+const base64Length = (bytes: number) => Math.ceil(bytes / 3) * 4;
+
+/** `DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS` overridden by the model's resize profile, as pi-durable's `read` does. */
+function imageLimits(model: DurableImageModel | undefined): ImageLimits {
+  const resize = model?.inputLimits?.images?.resize;
+  return {
+    maxWidth: resize?.maxWidth ?? DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS.maxWidth,
+    maxHeight: resize?.maxHeight ?? DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS.maxHeight,
+    // Never past the encoded limit images have on Pi.
+    maxBytes: Math.min(resize?.maxBytes ?? DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS.maxBytes, MAX_ENCODED_BYTES),
+  };
+}
+
+export interface DurableImageInput {
+  cwd: string;
+  model: DurableImageModel | undefined;
+  /** Resizes and converts images; without one, supported images within the limit pass as they are. */
+  processor: ImageProcessor | undefined;
+}
+
+async function loadImage(
+  input: DurableImageInput,
+  rawPath: unknown,
+  signal?: AbortSignal,
+): Promise<AttachedImage> {
+  const { file, bytes } = await readImageSource(input.cwd, rawPath, signal);
+  const mimeType = detectImageType(bytes);
+  if (!mimeType) throw new Error(`Not a supported image: ${file}`);
+  const limits = imageLimits(input.model);
+  const notes: string[] = [];
+  let image: { data: string; mimeType: string };
+  if (input.processor) {
+    const prepared = await input.processor.prepare(bytes, mimeType, limits);
+    checkAbort(signal);
+    if (!prepared) throw new Error(`Unable to prepare image for the model: ${file}`);
+    image = prepared;
+    if (prepared.convertedFrom !== undefined)
+      notes.push(`Converted from ${prepared.convertedFrom} to ${prepared.mimeType}.`);
+    if (prepared.resized !== undefined) {
+      const { from, to } = prepared.resized;
+      const scale = (from.width / to.width).toFixed(2);
+      notes.push(
+        `Resized from ${from.width}x${from.height} to ${to.width}x${to.height}. Multiply coordinates by ${scale} to map them to the original.`,
+      );
+    }
+  } else {
+    const unconfigured = "and the host configured no image processor";
+    if (!INLINE_TYPES.has(mimeType))
+      throw new Error(`${file} is an image (${mimeType}) that needs converting, ${unconfigured}`);
+    if (base64Length(bytes.length) > limits.maxBytes)
+      throw new Error(`${file} is too large to attach, ${unconfigured} to shrink it`);
+    image = { data: bytes.toString("base64"), mimeType };
+  }
+  if (Buffer.byteLength(image.data, "utf8") > MAX_ENCODED_BYTES)
+    throw new Error("Encoded image exceeds 5 MiB");
+  const omitted = textOnly(input.model);
+  if (omitted)
+    notes.push("The current model does not support images; it is left out of its requests.");
+  return {
+    image: { type: "image", data: image.data, mimeType: image.mimeType },
+    info: {
+      file,
+      mimeType: image.mimeType,
+      note: [`Read image file [${image.mimeType}].`, ...notes].join(" "),
+      omitted,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function textOnly(model: DurableImageModel | undefined): boolean {
+  return model !== undefined && !model.input.includes("image");
+}
+
+/**
+ * The images one pi-durable call attaches: `workspace.viewImage`, images for model requests, and
+ * images nested tools return, with the limits they have on Pi.
+ */
+export function createDurableImageCollector(input: DurableImageInput): ImageCollector {
+  return createImageAttachments({
+    load: (path, signal) => loadImage(input, path, signal),
+    omitted: () => textOnly(input.model),
+  });
+}

+import { constants } from "node:fs";
+import { open } from "node:fs/promises";
+
+import { checkAbort, resolveWorkspacePath, workspaceResultPath } from "./paths.js";
+
+/** An image content block, as Pi and pi-durable tool results carry it. */
+export interface ImageBlock {
+  type: "image";
+  data: string;
+  mimeType: string;
+}
+export interface ImageAttachmentInfo {
+  file: string;
+  mimeType: string;
+  note: string;
+  /** The model has no image input, so the host leaves the image out of its requests. */
+  omitted: boolean;
+}
+export interface AttachedImage {
+  image: ImageBlock;
+  info: ImageAttachmentInfo;
+}
+
+/** Collects the images one TypeScript invocation attaches to its result. */
+export interface ImageCollector {
+  view(
+    args: unknown[],
+    signal?: AbortSignal,
+  ): Promise<{ file: string; mimeType: string; queued: true }>;
+  /** Images attached so far, in call order. Pending and failed calls are excluded. */
+  attached(): AttachedImage[];
+  /**
+   * Attaches an image a tool returned. The tool call has already finished, so an image past
+   * the invocation's limits is recorded as an omission instead of failing the call.
+   */
+  attachBlock(image: ImageBlock, source: string): void;
+  /** Why returned images were not attached, in call order. */
+  omissions(): string[];
+  /** Reads one image for a model request as viewImage would, without attaching it. */
+  load(path: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ImageBlock>;
+}
+
+export const MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
+export const MAX_ENCODED_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
+// Per invocation, so one loop over a directory cannot flood the conversation with images.
+const MAX_IMAGES = 8;
+const MAX_TOTAL_ENCODED_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
+
+/** An image file's bytes, read once within the source limit. */
+export interface ImageSource {
+  /** The absolute path. */
+  path: string;
+  /** The path as results show it. */
+  file: string;
+  bytes: Buffer;
+}
+
+/** Reads an image file within the source limit, refusing non-regular files and growing files. */
+export async function readImageSource(
+  cwd: string,
+  rawPath: unknown,
+  signal?: AbortSignal,
+): Promise<ImageSource> {
+  const path = resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, rawPath);
+  const file = workspaceResultPath(cwd, path);
+  if (Buffer.byteLength(file) > 1024) throw new Error("Image path is too long for a result label");
+
+  // O_NONBLOCK prevents a pathname swapped to a FIFO between checks from hanging here.
+  const handle = await open(path, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NONBLOCK);
+  let buffer: Buffer;
+  try {
+    const info = await handle.stat();
+    if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error("Image path must refer to a regular file");
+    if (info.size > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) throw new Error("Image source exceeds 10 MiB");
+    buffer = Buffer.alloc(info.size + 1);
+    let length = 0;
+    while (length < buffer.length) {
+      checkAbort(signal);
+      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(buffer, length, buffer.length - length, null);
+      if (!bytesRead) break;
+      length += bytesRead;
+    }
+    if (length > info.size) throw new Error("Image changed size while reading; retry");
+    buffer = buffer.subarray(0, length);
+  } finally {
+    await handle.close();
+  }
+  checkAbort(signal);
+  return { path, file, bytes: buffer };
+}
+
+export interface ImageLoader {
+  /** Reads and prepares one image file. */
+  load(path: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AttachedImage>;
+  /** Whether the model has no image input, so the host leaves images out of its requests. */
+  omitted(): boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The invocation's image collector over a host's loader: the per-invocation limits, call order,
+ * and omissions are the same on every host.
+ */
+export function createImageAttachments(loader: ImageLoader): ImageCollector {
+  // Each call reserves a slot when it starts, so concurrent calls attach in call order. A failed
+  // call releases its slot; pending calls count toward the limit.
+  const slots: Array<{ loaded?: AttachedImage }> = [];
+  const attached = () => slots.flatMap(({ loaded }) => (loaded ? [loaded] : []));
+  const attachedBytes = () =>
+    attached().reduce((sum, { image }) => sum + Buffer.byteLength(image.data, "utf8"), 0);
+  const omitted: string[] = [];
+  const attachBlock = (image: ImageBlock, source: string) => {
+    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(image.data, "utf8");
+    const total = attachedBytes() + bytes;
+    const reason =
+      slots.length >= MAX_IMAGES
+        ? `at most ${MAX_IMAGES} images attach per invocation`
+        : bytes > MAX_ENCODED_BYTES
+          ? "the encoded image exceeds 5 MiB"
+          : total > MAX_TOTAL_ENCODED_BYTES
+            ? "images attached by one invocation would exceed 16 MiB encoded"
+            : undefined;
+    if (reason) {
+      omitted.push(`Image from ${source} not attached: ${reason}`);
+      return;
+    }
+    slots.push({
+      loaded: {
+        image: { type: "image", data: image.data, mimeType: image.mimeType },
+        info: {
+          file: source,
+          mimeType: image.mimeType,
+          note: `Returned by ${source}`,
+          omitted: loader.omitted(),
+        },
+      },
+    });
+  };
+  const view = async (args: unknown[], signal?: AbortSignal) => {
+    checkAbort(signal);
+    if (slots.length >= MAX_IMAGES)
+      throw new Error(`viewImage attaches at most ${MAX_IMAGES} images per invocation`);
+    const slot: { loaded?: AttachedImage } = {};
+    slots.push(slot);
+    try {
+      const loaded = await loader.load(args[0], signal);
+      const total = attachedBytes() + Buffer.byteLength(loaded.image.data, "utf8");
+      if (total > MAX_TOTAL_ENCODED_BYTES)
+        throw new Error("Images attached by one invocation exceed 16 MiB encoded");
+      slot.loaded = loaded;
+      return { file: loaded.info.file, mimeType: loaded.info.mimeType, queued: true as const };
+    } catch (error) {
+      slots.splice(slots.indexOf(slot), 1);
+      throw error;
+    }
+  };
+  const load = async (path: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
+    (await loader.load(path, signal)).image;
+  return { view, attached, attachBlock, omissions: () => [...omitted], load };
+}
